text: Fixing #5731 (unbounded PRG source loading), stacked on the preprocessor PR #6712: new PrgSourceLimits (per-source 64 MiB, session aggregate 256 MiB, per-program include aggregate, logical line 1 MiB incl. continued statements, 5M lines, 4096 includes), all checked from sizes/counts BEFORE allocating, configurable via RuntimeSessionOptions and CONFIG.FPW (MAXSOURCEBYTES etc.), localized diagnostics naming the source; host reads startup/packaged sources through the bounded snapshot overload (RuntimeHost.Error.SourceTooLarge). A 4 GiB sparse source is refused from its size alone. NOT done: removing the redundant whole-source copies kept after parsing (needs a debugger/verified-execution design). Tests: new test_prg_engine_source_limits (fails when the checks are disabled) plus a host test.
